limits.meaning: the analysis quota (--timeout-ms) counts analysis time only; declared slot waits are excluded up to the slot-wait limit; the overall wall limit stops the run whatever it declares

timing.slot_wait_meaning: wall time during which every route in flight waited for its gate slot; the host's --timeout-ms does not count it, up to its slot-wait limit (cards MEASURE-QUOTA-AND-INCREMENTAL, R7, and GATE-SLOT-FIFO-ORDER)
